title: Variational Quantum Dimension Reduction for Recurrent Quantum Models
summary: Recurrent quantum models (RQMs) realize sequential quantum processes through repeated application of a unitary operation on a memory system coupled with a series of output registers. However, such models often rely on unnecessarily large memory spaces, introducing redundancy and limiting scalability. Here, we introduce a \textit{variational quantum dimension reduction} framework that identifies and removes irrelevant memory degrees of freedom while preserving the recurrent dynamics of the target model.
